title: 4.14 Months: July to December
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
goal: Name the last six months of the year and say in which month your birthday is.
grammar_function: It is + month; What month is it? It is + month; My birthday is in + month.
prerequisite: 3.10 my; 4.3 in; 4.12 month, months, year; 4.13 January to June and What month is it?
speaking_outcome: Say It is October. and My birthday is in July.
